title: Share Settlement Amount on a Workmanship Share — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Share settlement on a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty set.** The credit settles only the tire part of a workmanship share charged on the same set, because that share pays for a replacement tire; it is never more than the credit remaining and never settles the share's mounting part.

**Defined quantities**
- **Credit remaining** — the credit issued by every treadwear adjustment entry of the set, less every credit-applied and credit-expired entry of the set.
- **Share owed** — the share charged on the set's latest workmanship replacement entry.
- **Share's mounting part** — the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire when the line charges mounting and balancing after the free period, and 0 otherwise.
- **Settleable part** — the share owed less the share's mounting part, never below 0.
- **Apportioning tire line** — the store's selling price of the same tire recorded on the set's latest treadwear adjustment, counted as 0 while the set has no adjustment entry.
- **Replacement ticket's mounting charge** — the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire, or 0 on a line that includes mounting with the adjustment credit.
- **Apportioning base** — the apportioning tire line plus that mounting charge.

**The settlement follows when the share was charged**
| Share recorded | Share settlement |
|---|---|
| at the inspection visit the latest treadwear adjustment rests on, that is with the same odometer | settled first: the smaller of the credit remaining and the settleable part |
| at an earlier visit (lower odometer) | apportioned with the replacement ticket: the credit remaining times the settleable part divided by the settleable part plus the apportioning base, never above the settleable part |
| any other share | waits behind the replacement ticket: the credit remaining less the apportioning base, never below 0 and never above the settleable part |

No intermediate figure is rounded; the share settlement is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Worked (hypothetical figures):** credit remaining $60.00, settleable part $40.00, apportioning base $160.00 — settled first: $40.00; apportioned: $60.00 times 40 divided by 200, $12.00; waiting behind the ticket: $60.00 less $160.00 is below 0, so $0.00.
